baselineDescription: 本轮开始冻结的前一轮已优化 C# Loader

protocol.execution: baseline then optimized; no concurrent agent builds or tests
protocol.allocationMetric: GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread; cumulative allocated bytes in timed operation, not peak or retained memory

pairing.onlyIntentionalFlagDifference: boundLoader false -> true selects internal CfdData constructor
pairing.duplicateWorkloads: wide and variants each measure 128 fields / 3 sparse variants in construction and full-load

limitations: Seven samples per case report median and observed range; no stable P95, confidence interval or significance claim.
Baseline full matrix precedes optimized full matrix; no randomized interleaving or repeated process-level runs.
All cases use the common string Get API. Generated ordinal calls are not measured.
Current-thread allocation is neither process peak nor retained memory. Forced GC does not reproduce application GC scheduling.
For cached cases, 50000 calls are measured after priming; zero measured allocation does not apply to first views or arbitrary dimension combinations.
Table-registration excludes context and type-index preparation. Construction and full-load include this work.
No Unity, Mono, IL2CPP, mobile-device or actual game-project measurements.
Do not combine these samples with earlier reports that use a different baseline, sample protocol or fixture suite.
